simple.meaning: גִּבּוֹר (gibbôwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “powerful ; by implication, warrior , tyrant.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 160 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, Ruth, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 6:4. Its contexts include family, family line, kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּבּוֹר (H1368).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גִּבּוֹר (gibbôwr) / H1368 is traced through Genesis 6:4, Genesis 10:8, Genesis 10:9, Deuteronomy 10:17 as a generated source-based concept entry.
